contents_tesim: Most of the CPA version of the Epistle to the Hebrews has been previously unknown.
full_text_tesim: Ancient CPA | Good regular hand; punctuation by double, triple, and quadruple points; use of "capital" letters written in the margin to indicate beginning of a new verse (fols. 1ra, 1vb, 2ra, 2rb, 2vb)
Most of the CPA version of the Epistle to the Hebrews has been previously unknown.
The two folios belong probably to a book of Epistles; the missing text between them probably corresponds to four folios (eight pages)
